_readme: Tool-selection eval set: 40 things a family might say. Written by the coding agent at the team's request (2026-10-11), deliberately in casual, indirect phrasing that avoids the tool descriptions' wording. Because the same agent wrote the tool descriptions, treat results as optimistic; human-written additions are welcome (ids h-*). 'expect.tool' is the first tool Alexa should call; 'expect.args' must appear (case-insensitive substring on strings, exact otherwise). 'alt' lists other acceptable first tools.
author: agent (Claude Code), reviewed by: (pending)
